candidate.answerReason: Twenty-four hamburgers require three batches of eight, so the meat needed is 3·3 = 9 pounds.

methods.label: Scale the number of batches
methods.explanation:
The \(24\) hamburgers make \(24\div8=3\) batches of \(8\). Each batch needs \(3\) pounds of meat, so Rachelle needs
\[
3\times3=\boxed{9}\text{ pounds},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses whole-number batches and elementary multiplication and division, appropriate for AMC 8.

candidate.annotationRationale: Direct proportion is the target because multiplying the hamburger count by three multiplies the required meat by three. The batch method uses the meanings of multiples and division.
